name: FlashTrade
rootCause: FlashTrade (a Solana perps protocol) detected an unauthorized $98,000 withdrawal from its ephemeral instance. As a precaution, trading, deposits, and withdrawals were paused. Thanks to the newly rolled-out withdrawal batching and monitoring system, the incident was detected quickly and contained. The team will fully cover the amount, with all user funds safe.

descriptions.text: FlashTrade (a Solana perps protocol) detected an unauthorized $98,000 withdrawal from its ephemeral instance. As a precaution, trading, deposits, and withdrawals were paused. Thanks to the newly rolled-out withdrawal batching and monitoring system, the incident was detected quickly and contained. The team will fully cover the amount, with all user funds safe.

FlashTrade, a Solana-based perpetuals DEX, was exploited on July 21, 2026 after insufficient validation of the buffer account in MagicBlock's undelegation logic. A forged account bypassed program-derived address checks, enabling an unauthorized withdrawal of ~$98,000 USDC. The incident was detected within minutes and operations paused. All users were reimbursed and the vulnerable SDK was rapidly patched. The MagicBlock SDK's undelegation instruction accepted attacker-supplied buffer accounts without verifying that they matched the canonical program-derived address (PDA). This omission enabled a forged account to bypass intended authentication and withdraw funds.
